text:
maria: Heads up — fncall schema rejects spiked in eu-west after last canary. Dashboard shows a 6x jump in 'rejects_per_min' for /invoke-tool.

raj: saw that. sampling telemetry missing route_id for ~20% of rejects, so console counts may be under-attr'd. link: https://console.redwood/ops/alerts/348

sasha: any obvious schema change in canary? which validator version?

maria: canary used validator v2.4.1 -> prod validator v2.3.8. snippet:
```
validation_error: "missing property 'tool_response'"
payload: {"action":"invoke","model":"gptx-1"}
```

ops: rollback? or a permissive fallback on the gate to avoid billing/regressions?

sasha: suggest temporary soft-fail route: mark rejects as nonfatal, tag with 'validation_soft' and route to degen-model. need console support to surface soft-fail counts and per-route quota impact.

eve: agree — Console: add 'validation outcome' filter and per-route delta chart. can wire up sample metadata if validator emits `route_id`.

maria: re: quota — rejects are currently counting against attempt quota which is blowing through customer budgets. if we soft-fail we need to avoid billing customers for invalid responses.

raj: quick PR: change meter to charge only on successful parse (PR #1227). I'll open it now.

deploy-bot: Canary completed: validator v2.4.1 promoted at 2026-03-22T09:12:30Z :white_check_mark:

maria: ok, let's pause further promotions until we patch telemetry + meter change. I'll file a runbook entry.
